privacy: Source evidence is public vendor documentation or public sample producer output. Authored fixtures use synthetic opaque values. No captured customer payloads are included.

google_live_interaction.decision: Extend vendor/google-ima-interaction to the exact /pagead/live/interaction and /pagead/live/interaction/ paths on pubads.g.doubleclick.net.

producer.method: Fetch the documented Google Single Inline Linear sample ad unit through Google's live ad producer. Inspect the resulting interaction callbacks without firing them.
producer.observation: Generated callbacks use pubads.g.doubleclick.net/pagead/live/interaction/ and retain populated ai, sigh and label fields. The standard sample producer emits the existing /pagead/interaction/ spelling with the same field set.

contracts.label: recommended nonempty event label, warning; no closed enumeration

limits: Producer-template completeness does not establish server rejection policy.
Opaque signed fields are not authenticated or decoded.
No prefix, parent-domain or arbitrary Google-host match is added.
The response also contains live PCS paths outside this change's requested endpoint scope.

google_pagead2_pcs_view.decision: Retain recognized-vendor core-only coverage for pagead2.googlesyndication.com/pcs/view. Do not borrow the CM360 or IMA sai advisory.
google_pagead2_pcs_view.reason: No independent primary producer template or documented wire contract for this host and route was found in the reviewed sources. The observed absence of sai in private corpus rows is a scope warning, not a published requiredness contract.

reviewed_sources.observation: No literal PCS view constructor found.
Reviewed the public AdSense loader and its implementation script without finding a literal pagead2 PCS view template.
Current standard IMA sample generated securepubads PCS view with xai, sai and sig.
Its documented /6355419/Travel/Europe/France/Paris display sample ad unit produced securepubads PCS view with xai, sai and sig. It did not provide the pagead2 contract.

google_pagead2_pcs_view.regression: Synthetic pagead2 URLs remain outside vendor/google-cm360-pcs-view and vendor/google-ima-pcs even when sai is absent.

directory_attribution.section: Services Privacy Policy, section 2, How do we collect data
directory_attribution.evidence: The first-party services policy explicitly identifies creativecdn.com as the domain RTB House operates under.
directory_attribution.scope: Attribute the exact observed ams host. No endpoint field contract is inferred.

directory_attribution.evidence: The first-party homepage links its own Kimberlite-branded landing page describing an advertising traffic buying and optimization platform.
directory_attribution.scope: Attribute the exact host. Its private tracker fields and path payloads receive no invented rules.

directory_attribution.evidence: First-party Yandex documentation establishes Adfox ownership, video event tracking, and the neighboring /ads/adfox/ ad request prefix. The supplied inventory identifies /adfox/ event and goLink routes on Yandex's own host.
directory_attribution.scope: Use path-restricted directory attribution only. The reviewed public examples do not establish the exact /adfox/ event wire contract. Bare yandex.ru and unrelated paths must remain unmatched by this entry.

unresolved_attribution.decision: Retain unknown-vendor coverage instead of assigning an unverified owner.
unresolved_attribution.reviewed_evidence: https://cdn7.ufouxbwn.com/ redirects to https://playmatic.video/, whose first-party page identifies Playmatic. Requests to the im1 root returned HTTP 503; the bare root domain did not resolve during review.
unresolved_attribution.reason: A sibling CDN redirect supports a Playmatic family inference but does not independently establish ownership of the im1 tracker host or any tracker field contract.
